notable_absence.finding: Like the overview page, this dedicated task page never states which role is authorized to trigger graceful failover - the UI/CLI/REST examples all use the 'Full Administrator username of Administrator', but that is the page's own worked-example setup assumption, not an asserted RBAC gate, so requiresServerRole is deliberately not recorded here.

cross_component_finding: Graceful failover's UI flow independently confirms the two-step 'failover completes, then a SEPARATE rebalance is still required' shape already seen for node-addition and node-join: 'Graceful failover is now initiated, and a rebalance occurs as part of the procedure' followed later by 'an additional rebalance is required to complete the reduction of the cluster to one node' - i.e. one rebalance runs automatically as part of the failover call itself, and a second, manually-triggered rebalance is still needed afterward to actually eject the node. This is a finer-grained wrinkle than add-node-and-rebalance's single completes relation captures, and is worth reconciliation attention: rebalance may be invoked automatically AND manually within the same procedure, not just once per operation.
